title: Pandiyan
desc: Pandiyan, a police officer, is enraged when his sister's husband dies. In order to find and catch the culprits, he goes undercover

title: Duet
desc: Two musician brothers, Guna and Siva, end up falling in love with Anjali, a choreographer. However, the brothers have a rift when Siva becomes possessive of Anjali.

title: Iravum Pagalum Varu
desc: Karthi, a college student, indulges in petty thieving. But his life changes when a corrupt police officer decides to use him for performing illegal activities.

title: Parthen Rasithen
desc: Shankar, a graduate, awaits recruitment and lives as a tenant with Bhanu who seeks his company to stay away from her stepbrother. Meanwhile, Shankar begins to fall in love with Sarika.

title: Dummy Tappasu
desc: An obese man, living in the slums of Chennai, comes across a series of situations that change his perception towards life and love.

title: Iniyavaley
desc: Prabhakar is firm on marrying only after he clears his exams and becomes a collector. When his parents fix his marriage, his protests lead to complications and he ends up marrying the bride's sister.

title: Amma Appa Cheliam
desc: Chellam, a boy from a poor family, is in love with a rich girl but ignores her by focusing on his career while making his parents proud by scoring the highest in the district.

title: Cheran Chozhan Pandian
desc: After being released from jail Cheran, Chozhan, and Pandian are determined to reform, they encounter the corrupt politician Swamy. They befriend Gayathri, Swamy's sister, leading to complications.

title: Pattayya Kelappannum Pandi Yaa
desc: Velpandiyan, a minibus driver, falls in love with Kanmani, a regular commuter of the bus. However, they face several challenges as their relationship grows further.

title: Coimbatore Mappllai
desc: Balu comes to the city for better opportunities and stays with his friend. He falls in love with Sumithra, his landlord, but her evil cousin, Mahesh, creates a rift between them.

title: Mariyathai
desc: Annamalai is a highly respected man whose son, Raja, falls in love with Radha, a music teacher. Radha manages to manipulate Raja into giving up his property.

title: Muthuramalingam
desc: A respected martial arts expert finds himself in a sticky situation during a competition that threatens his life and the pride of his community.

title: Vandi
desc: Three roommates, who are trying to make their ends meet, land in trouble due to a stolen bike that has been extensively used by robbers for executing their plans

title: Shakalka Baby
desc: Sundaran and Pandi are married to two sisters who henpeck them and live together in the same house. When a young girl enters their house claiming to be pregnant, the men are distracted by her beauty

title: Chinna Chinna Kannile
desc: When Raju loses his soft-spoken, loving elder brother Balu in a fight, he gives up his violent ways. However, his life changes for the better when he meets his brother's lookalike, who is a criminal.

title: Agilan
desc: Madurai's ACP gets the heat from his seniors for his team's poor performance. In order to mend that, he plans a fake operation for his team. But his plan goes awry due to a meddling sub-inspector.

title: Kaalatpadai
desc: Sridhar fights with Ram for dating his sister. Ram and Priya get married secretly with the help of Ram's parents and friends. Ram's father advises him to find a job and then start a married life.
